datasets.name: PaymentInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT  p.id,p.creditid, paydate, payedamt, payedintamt, payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, payedpenaltyamt, tridamt, tridintamt, triddueamt,
       triddueintamt, tridpenaltyamt, tridprimreserve, tridsecreserve,
       outtridobligation,BKAMMOUNT,h.rest,h.interestrest  INTEREST
  FROM cm_payments p, cm_history h
WHERE
p.creditid=h.creditid  and
 p.CreditID=:CREDITID and 
h.hdate=p.paydate
ORDER BY PayDate DESC

datasets.name: PaymentAccounts
datasets.sql:
SELECT   a.id AS accid, a.kli_id, a.acc_no AS accountnumber , abs(t.OSTAT) as Rest, v.VAL_NAME
    FROM ACCOUNT  a ,
         TENOSTAT t ,
         AVALUTE  v
   WHERE (    a.kli_id = :kli_id
          AND a.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                            FROM cm_aginfo
                           WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                              FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                             WHERE g.iname = 'ClientAccs'))
         )
         AND t.Acc_ID = a.ID
         AND v.VALUTE = a.VAL_ACC
UNION ALL
SELECT   a.id AS accid, a.kli_id, a.acc_no AS accountnumber , abs(t.OSTAT) as Rest, v.VAL_NAME
    FROM ACCOUNT  a ,
         TENOSTAT t ,
         AVALUTE  v
   WHERE ((bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                         FROM cm_aginfo
                        WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                           FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                          WHERE g.iname = 'InternalBankAccs'))
          )
         )
         AND t.Acc_ID = a.ID
         AND v.VALUTE = a.VAL_ACC
         
ORDER BY kli_id, accountnumber

   CM_COMMON.AccountNumber_Get(D.LOANACCID) as ACC_NO,

 , CM_CURR_STATE C

datasets.name: expcrdcnt_
datasets.sql:
select 
cm_utils.bankdaysbetween (MIN (psh.paymentdate),
                                   :dat
                                  ) AS exdatcount
                                  
from   cm_payment_schedule psh ,cm_curr_state cs
where  psh.rest < cs.rest+cs.duerest and (cs.duerest+cs.rest - psh.rest >= 0.5) 
and psh.creditid = cs.creditid
and psh.paymentdate <=:dat
and psh.creditid = :crdid
group by psh.creditid
